title.zh: 查询用户是否在线（旧版）

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明

该接口支持批量查询，每次最多可以查询20个用户是否在线。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~343507~~)。
descriptions.en:
## Usage notes

This operation supports batch queries. You can query the online status of up to 20 users at a time.

## QPS limits

The single-user queries per second (QPS) limit for this operation is 100 times/second. If you exceed this limit, API calls will be throttled, which may affect your business. You should make API calls at a reasonable rate. For more information, see [QPS limits](~~343507~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live batch-get-online-users --app-id a494caec-000-695ef345db77 --group-id 23wcaec-000695ef --user-ids de100a0,hu009 --region cn-hangzhou
